Documentation.TagDescription:
**Product Assortments**

Access the assortment groups that classify the product catalog. Use it to resolve the assortment behind an item, or to list the available groups.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This endpoint exposes classification data only; it holds no pricing or stock information.

MethodDocumentation.GET: You can retrieve **all assortments** used to group the `product catalog`, including their code and description. Products reference these groups through their assortment.
